newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel diffs move higher, helped by refiners.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel diffs move higher, helped by refiners.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials jumped Wednesday as refiners entered the market as buyers, traders said.
"Late last night and early this morning it looked like we could move lower, but some of the big boys came in looking for barrels," one trader said.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for back 11th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline was talked between 1.60 and 1.75 cents over the NYMEX print near the settlement, up about 0.30 cent on the day.
Earlier in the day, Citgo reportedly purchased 100,000 barrels of USG 54-grade material from Koch for the back 11th cycle at 1.50 cents over the NYMEX.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade was offered at 4.25 cents over the screen, up about 0.15 cent on the day, while prompt 55-grade was unchanged, with offers at 4.75 cents over.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 858 1620
